evidence.mission_note: As a future keeper this is the preferred S52 manual M Roadster at a modest price within the ideal band, so it does not strain cash preservation. Its 152K miles mean the keeper case depends entirely on records and the rear structure, which are claimed but not yet shown.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes, by photos, a visually stock black-on-black 1998 M Roadster with a 5-speed manual, good paint and worn but intact seats. Everything mechanical rests on seller prose: a cooling refresh at ~90K, a 'timing-related' service at ~130K, 'subframe welds intact', and a pre-listing PPI with no issues. None of these comes with an invoice, photo or report. The one observed item is that the last claimed cooling work is about 62K miles old, so a refresh is due regardless. No VIN or history report is provided, and the Vermont plate on a Connecticut car leaves the title state open. At $13,000 the asking price sits slightly under the $13,901 fair-value mid, in line with high-mileage sold comps. The decisive open items are the rear structure, the substance of the ~130K service, and title and VIN history, all of which the seller says exist and could produce.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, a title photo and the pre-listing PPI report, along with trunk-floor and underside photos and the ~130K service invoice, before the end-of-October delisting window.
